title: Clear part opener
description: Opens a part of the module: the part's number set large in the accent, then the opening's head (the part's title and its lead) and its page, on the left columns of the grid.
instructions: The first screen of a section, with the screen style section and the backdrop feature. number: the part's number on two digits (01, 02…), the only mark of where the learner is: nothing else goes above the title. The title names the part; lead says what it covers; the body holds one text block with the style checklist (three points at most).

number.title: Part number
number.description: The part's number, set large in the accent above the title (01, 02…).
